stem.en: Two tokens have the token ids 464 and 465. What does that tell you?

text.en: Their meanings are close to each other
The second token is a longer piece of text
They have next-door numbers in the token list
The model reads the second one after the first

explanation.en: A token id is only a token's number in the token list. Next-door numbers can hold unrelated tokens, so the ids say nothing about meaning, and they do not set the order of reading.
